claim.claim-text: 2. The oral irrigator of claim 1, wherein the rack bracket comprises one or more longitudinal grooves, wherein the one or more longitudinal grooves are configured to allow the rack to slide laterally relative to the bracket.

3. The oral irrigator of claim 1 or 2, wherein the pressure assembly further comprises a regulator housing, a dual valve assembly, and a pressure valve, wherein the dual valve assembly and the pressure valve are configured to be received in a valve compartment defined by the regulator housing.
4. The oral irrigator of claim 3, wherein the pressure valve includes a gear face for interfacing with and connecting to the gear, and a sealing face.
5. The oral irrigator of claim 3 or 4, wherein the sealing face varies in thickness and includes a flow channel defined therein.
6. The oral irrigator of claim 5, wherein the flow channel varies in dimension and shape and extends in a generally curved manner around a central area of the sealing face.

7. The oral irrigator of any of claims 5 or 6, wherein the pressure assembly further comprises a seal configured to be biased against the sealing face of the pressure valve, wherein the seal includes a flow aperture defined therethrough, and wherein the flow aperture is in fluid communication with the flow channel of the sealing face and the main channel.
8. The oral irrigator of claim 3, wherein the regulator housing includes a main body defining a main channel fluidly connecting the reservoir to the pump.

9. The oral irrigator of claim 8, wherein the valve compartment is defined on a side of the main body and comprises a cavity for receiving the pressure valve, two securing features connected to either side of the compartment, a valve inlet and a valve outlet, wherein the valve inlet is configured to be fluidly connected to the main channel, and the valve outlet is fluidly connected to a housing inlet.

10. The oral irrigator of claim 8 or 9, wherein the main body defines a housing inlet and a housing outlet, wherein the housing inlet is fluidly connected to the main channel and extends from a first end of the main body and wherein the housing outlet is defined on the opposite end of the main channel and is configured to be in fluid communication with the main channel.

11. The oral irrigator of any of claims 8 to 10, wherein the dual valve assembly is configured to be received in the main channel, wherein the dual valve assembly is further configured to regulate fluid into and out of the reservoir into a pump chamber and to help prevent damage to the pump in the event of a blockage of flow through the handle and wherein the dual valve assembly includes a valve housing configured to slide within the main channel, wherein the valve housing includes a terminal end having an aperture defined through a front surface thereof and includes a second end with a seal cap that includes a flow channel defined therethrough.
12. The oral irrigator of claims 3 or 11, wherein the dual valve assembly further includes a spring actuated valve positioned within the valve housing.
13. The oral irrigator of claim 3, wherein the regulator housing includes brackets configured to receive fasteners for securing the regulator housing within the base unit.
14. The oral irrigator of claim 1, wherein the actuator is received within a recess defined in an outer surface of the base unit.

15. The oral irrigator of claim 14, wherein the recess defines a recessed track on a sidewall of the base unit and includes a plurality of openings for connecting the actuator to the rack received in the base unit.
